bed_reason: Trailers checked: Steam 'Risen Ballbylon DLC | Out Now' (33 s; audio split not applied twice, leftover 35.7% and 38.3% effects against the 5% limit, music 21 to 23%) and Steam 'Risen Ballbylon' (leftover 6.5%, shots from other seconds would carry effects that do not match). Both are effects-led gameplay mixes with the trailer's firework and unlock stingers, and the clean picture stretches are not one continuous run (title logo at 2.5 to 5 s, dark island at 7.5 to 9 s and 13 to 14 s, NEW CORE BALLS card at 17 to 18.4 s), so our bed goes under the clean stretches.
